capabilities.name: governance.crown
capabilities.notes: Policy arbitration and decision gating are implemented; production evidence remains gate-controlled.

capabilities.name: authentication.jwt_oidc
capabilities.notes: JWT/OIDC and tenant isolation are implemented. Public authentication error sanitization remains a release blocker.

capabilities.name: authorization.rbac_abac
capabilities.notes: Centralized RBAC/ABAC decision point is implemented. Billing-specific scopes are defined and must be wired into billing handlers before release.

capabilities.name: monetization.payments
capabilities.notes: Stripe top-up ownership validation, durable PaymentIntent binding and server-created tenant-bound intents are implemented. Legacy billing checkout/run capability wiring remains a release blocker.

capabilities.name: billing.checkout_idempotency
capabilities.notes: Durable idempotency storage exists, but the legacy /api/billing checkout handler still needs to consume it before this capability can be marked production-safe.

capabilities.name: billing.run_capability
capabilities.notes: Durable one-time capability persistence and least-privilege policy are implemented as building blocks; legacy authorize-run handler still returns an ephemeral token.

capabilities.name: security.secret_redaction
capabilities.notes: Provider credential registry expanded to Stripe, AI, Mux, Redis/KV, Supabase, database and signing/encryption secrets.

capabilities.name: linting.eslint_prettier
capabilities.notes: Local lint is green (0 errors / 0 warnings) and the Nitro/Vercel preflight gate now validates the built .vercel/output artifact. CI sign-off remains pending because GitHub Actions execution is blocked by an account billing lock.

capabilities.name: database.migrations
capabilities.notes: Billing security schema is versioned. Live migration replay and restore evidence are still required.

capabilities.name: cicd.vercel_workflows
capabilities.notes: Workflows and vercel.json are hardened and the local production gate is green. GitHub Actions execution is currently blocked by an account billing lock (jobs never start, ~4s); Vercel deploys independently of GitHub Actions on push to main.

capabilities.name: ncua.v2_academic_pipeline
capabilities.notes: Tokenless byte patching with SOPHIA E0–E4 classification, canonical ERI ≥ 95 gate with iterative refinement, QUP SHA3-512 merkle seal, and BookPI append-only ledger with HMAC-SHA3-512. Shared key derived from AEGIS_AUDIT_SECRET or injected for tests.

capabilities.name: igds.genesis_document_seal
capabilities.notes: Genesis document seal nativo: canonicalización JCS RFC 8785, firmas Ed25519 (ML-DSA-65 enchufable), id_alg P-521 conceptual, manifiesto C2PA-style JSON, registro append-only con inclusión/consistencia Merkle RFC 6962, revocación firmada y transporte RFC 3161 con verificación imprint-only. 26 tests verdes; migración PostgreSQL pendiente de aplicar en base viva.

test_summary.note: Historical counts are intentionally not asserted as current evidence until CI reruns against the current commit.

release_blockers: Wire dedicated billing scopes and step-up authentication into the legacy billing handlers.
Replace legacy authorize-run ephemeral authToken with durable one-time capability consumption.
Wire durable checkout idempotency into the legacy checkout handler.
Clear capability-matrix ESLint/Prettier failures and obtain fresh CI evidence.
Sanitize authentication verification errors at the public boundary and retain detail only in server telemetry.
